explanations.title: Avoids duplicate inline comments for nearby findings
explanations.summary: A finding is no longer reposted just because its wording changed: an earlier marked comment also counts as a match when it is on the same file within three lines. If GitHub no longer reports that comment’s current line, the original line is used; replies are ignored. Exact marker matches still count regardless of location.
